messages:
Nina Rao: Quick sync: KeyBridge asked for a joint listing in their cloud marketplace + a BYOK/HSM demo path for enterprise customers. They want SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning working end-to-end, plus a secrets-manager connector (Hashi/SecretsVault) example. Can we map owners?

Devon Hart: I'll take SAML + SCIM verification. Plan: run through their IdP metadata, test attribute mappings, and confirm group sync behavior. Need a partner sandbox tenant and a sample user CSV.

Oscar Lin: I'll drive the secrets-manager connector sample (Hashi + Vault plugins). Question: do we show only managed secrets or include a managed-secret-mirroring demo? Mirror adds complexity but is useful for migration stories.

Priya Desai: Security must approve the mirroring threat model. For marketplace we can start with a read-only demo (no secrets write) to reduce risk. Also we need KMS attestations for any HSM-backed claims.

Aaron Blake: Ops/infra: I'll prepare a BYOK flow doc + an HSM-backed flow. For HSM we'll provide attestation certs (FIPS/PIV) and an example of keywrap using RSA-OAEP. I can also spin a short-lived HSM test host for their SI team.

kb-integ-bot: new_ticket: KeyBridge integration epic created -> https://keybridge.atlassian.net/browse/KB-812

Devon Hart: Put a small checklist here for SAML/SCIM:
```
- Ingest IdP metadata (SAML) -> test SP-initiated login
- SCIM: user create/update/delete -> propagation tests
- Group sync mapping -> sample roles (admin, dev, observer)
- SCIM rate limits -> increase in staging
- Log format -> include SCIM event IDs
```
I'll need someone from docs to draft the quickstart (2 pages).

Priya Desai: Compliance note: KeyBridge requires SOC2 attestation plus EU-data residency for listed customers. Marketplace listing must include a data residency toggle and an SLA blurb. Legal will want to approve copy.

Oscar Lin: Re: secrets mirroring, idea: show a migration tool that does one-way copy with a TTL and audit log. Demo script would include:
1) export secrets from KeyBridge vault (read-only creds)
2) ingest into Redwood-managed cache with read-only flag
3) rotate keys on consume and show audit trail
Probably OK if security signs off.

Aaron Blake: Timeline check: if we start tomorrow, infra can deliver test HSM + BYOK doc in 5 business days. SAML/SCIM verification needs 3 business days once partner sandbox is available. Docs and marketplace assets need marketing + legal review, so factor 72h for signoff.

Nina Rao: Let's lock a go/no-go meeting. Proposed: Mon 2026-05-04 09:30 PT. Agenda: integration readiness, attestation artifacts, marketplace package, embargo/announce timing. Will invite KeyBridge PM.

Devon Hart: I've requested the sandbox tenant from KeyBridge (contact: integrations@keybridge.io). Asked for SCIM creds and IdP metadata.

Priya Desai: I'll coordinate with sec-arch to draft the attestation checklist and a short threat-model memo. Expect a draft by Thursday.

Oscar Lin: Can docs assign someone to the quickstart? @nina if not, I can write a 1-pager and marketing can expand.

Aaron Blake: I'll upload sample terraform + keypolicy snippet to the repo -> github.com/redwood-inference/partner-samples/keybridge. Will also drop certs and attestation steps in the ticket.

kb-integ-bot: keybridge_ci: new pipeline created for partner-e2e -> https://ci.redwood.dev/pipelines/partner-keybridge-e2e

Nina Rao: Owners recap: Devon = SAML/SCIM; Oscar = secrets connector + demo script; Aaron = BYOK/HSM infra + attestation; Priya = security & compliance; Nina = partner liaison + go/no-go. Meeting invite sent. Thanks everyone. :partyparrot:
